standalone_execution.method: All compiled Gradle test classes discovered by the unchanged JUnit5 runtime engines, directly in one JVM; same verification working directory. Gradle worker runs below failed from native thread exhaustion. No test filter or assertion was weakened.

notes: The first app attempt had no staged generated voice bundle; the pinned existing bundle was then staged. App compilation and seven parser tests subsequently passed.

Standalone Gradle test-worker creation failed with OutOfMemoryError unable to create native thread; no product behavioral failure was hidden. Direct JUnit uses the same compiled classes/runtime and found/executed all1330 tests.

The first direct launcher used the repository directory instead of the verification directory; file-based vectors/resources failed. Its result is retained; the final unchanged suite uses its actual Gradle working directory.

Earlier native history tests overlapped an active browser run and had thread errors; earlier runtime fixtures lacked the new empty DealList response; an API assertion initially compared Decimal string formatting rather than its amount. Final source guards/oracles were retained.

semantics: Complete native deal windows, independent cash/deal cursors, row precision, signed commission, native scope, original statement identity/availability and changed-history conflicts are preserved.
Both original runtime producers store a current native mark separately from earlier background results; native I/O cannot be backdated into original availability.
Repeatable read snapshots do not acquire a financial writer reservation; actual independent SQLite/PostgreSQL writers can commit while the original owner read stays coherent.
Complete original query coverage and native balance versions/post-balances are required. Native closing costs are preserved but fee-allocation/settlement semantics are not inferred.
External capital and separate IB/management business income are removed/labeled in native dollar PnL. Percentage returns across missing historical normalized credit/equity remain unmeasured.

Marked account returns and sampled drawdowns do not establish strategy alpha, settled trade profitability or historical causal learning. Knowledge watermark is latest-observed, not as-known-at-trade-time.
The two existing paired-owner read routes and Android account SDK carry exact native IDs/money, period bases and unknown qualification. No frontend redesign or financial-effect endpoint is added.
